title: Prove a seat's lifecycle live: spawn, record, done line, retire
why: Prevents the seat lifecycle from being proven only against a stub herdr. The O-09 suite passed on fixture records while no live seat had ever written one; this declaration starts a cheap throwaway seat through the real spawner so the done line reaching the principal and the seat exiting can be seen for real.

trigger.condition: After a change to bin/workflow-spawn.sh, bin/seat-watch.sh or bin/seat-record.sh, run: bin/workflow-spawn.sh seat-smoke smoke --ticket SMOKE-1 --brief-file <one-line brief>.

gates.why: The smoke seat proves the lifecycle, not a tree; its gate passes at once so the gate watcher is seen to arm and end.

exit.condition: The seat's last act is bin/seat-record.sh passed --note '<first line>'; the principal pane receives the done line and the seat watcher retires the seat.
